mapper.select: SELECT cp.task_id AS taskId, MIN(cp.input_time) AS actualStart, MAX(cp.output_time) AS actualEnd FROM qxx_pro_card_process cp WHERE cp.task_id IN #{id} GROUP BY cp.task_id

SELECT MIN(t.start_time) AS planStart, MAX(t.end_time) AS planEnd, MIN(cp.input_time) AS actualStart, MAX(cp.output_time) AS actualEnd FROM qxx_pro_task t LEFT JOIN qxx_pro_card_process cp ON cp.task_id = t.task_id AND cp.factory_id = t.factory_id WHERE t.workorder_id = #{workorderId}

SELECT 'WORKORDER' AS object_type, w.workorder_id AS object_id, w.workorder_code AS object_code, w.workorder_id AS workorder_id, w.workorder_code AS workorder_code, w.workorder_name AS object_name, w.product_name, w.request_date, w.finish_date AS actual_end_time, w.status, DATEDIFF(NOW(), w.request_date) AS overdue_days, ROUND(IFNULL(w.quantity_produced,0)/NULLIF(w.quantity,0)*100,0) AS progress_percent FROM qxx_pro_workorder w
w.status IN ('PREPARE','PRODUCING') AND w.request_date IS NOT NULL
AND w.request_date < CURDATE() AND w.request_date >= CURDATE() AND w.request_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{warnDays} DAY)
AND (w.request_date < CURDATE() OR (w.request_date >= CURDATE() AND w.request_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{warnDays} DAY)))
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM qxx_pro_task pt INNER JOIN qxx_md_workstation mws ON mws.workstation_id = pt.workstation_id AND mws.factory_id = pt.factory_id WHERE pt.workorder_id = w.workorder_id AND pt.factory_id = w.factory_id AND mws.workshop_id = #{workshopId} )
AND (w.workorder_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR w.workorder_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
ORDER BY w.request_date ASC

SELECT 'TASK' AS object_type, t.task_id AS object_id, t.task_code AS object_code, t.workorder_id AS workorder_id, w.workorder_code AS workorder_code, t.task_name AS object_name, w.product_name, ws.workshop_id, wshop.workshop_name, t.workstation_name, t.end_time AS plan_time, w.request_date, t.finish_date AS actual_end_time, t.status, DATEDIFF(NOW(), t.end_time) AS overdue_days, ROUND(IFNULL(t.quantity_produced,0)/NULLIF(t.quantity,0)*100,0) AS progress_percent FROM qxx_pro_task t LEFT JOIN qxx_pro_workorder w ON w.workorder_id = t.workorder_id AND w.factory_id = t.factory_id LEFT JOIN qxx_md_workstation ws ON ws.workstation_id = t.workstation_id AND ws.factory_id = t.factory_id LEFT JOIN qxx_md_workshop wshop ON wshop.workshop_id = ws.workshop_id AND wshop.factory_id = t.factory_id
t.status IN ('PREPARE','NORMAL','PRODUCING','PAUSED') AND t.end_time IS NOT NULL AND ws.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM qxx_pro_feedback fb WHERE fb.task_id = t.task_id AND fb.factory_id = t.factory_id AND fb.team_id = #{teamId} LIMIT 1)
AND t.end_time < NOW() AND t.end_time >= NOW() AND t.end_time <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{warnHours} HOUR)
AND (t.end_time < NOW() OR (t.end_time >= NOW() AND t.end_time <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{warnHours} HOUR)))
AND (t.task_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR t.task_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
ORDER BY t.end_time ASC
